projectTree.branch.hasIt: project_tree {tree}[{at}]: a branch already has {name} directly under the root (rename it in that branch, or merge it into main first)
projectTree.kind.cannotChange: project_tree {tree}[{at}]: {name} is now a section of kind {kind}. The kind (type) cannot be changed alone (add one under another name and move what it holds)
projectTree.rename.targetMissing: renames top_section {from} → {to}: project_tree has no {to} (when renaming, set the name in project_tree to {to} too)
